title: Junior/Fresher Performance Marketing (US Market)
subtitle: I.
body:
### **I. GENERAL INTRODUCTION **

PATI Group is searching for young and ambitious Marketers to train as the next generation of Performance Marketers for our x20 growth goal. This is not a “coffee-runner” apprenticeship. You will work directly on ad accounts for the US/EU markets, access real-world data systems, and be mentored by leading Seniors in the Global E-commerce industry.

### **II. JOB DESCRIPTION **

You will start with the smallest tasks, but they require absolute precision:

**1. Campaign Execution (40%):**

- **Implementation:** Support seniors in setting up campaigns **on Meta Ads, Google Ads** according to approved strategies.

- **Control:** Conduct **daily audits of ad account statuses** to ensure everything operates smoothly.

**2. Data & Reporting (30%):**

- **Metrics Update:** Perform Daily Reports and cross-check data between Ad Dashboards (Meta/Google) and the system Backend to ensure data integrity.

- **Risk Alert:** Closely monitor fluctuating metrics (spiking CPM, dropping ROAS, click fraud, etc.) and report immediately to Management for timely handling.

- **Analysis:** Support the team in conducting in-depth breakdown analysis (by device, location, age, etc.) as requested.

**3. Integrity & Compliance (20%):**

- **Policy Mastery:** Research and continuously update yourself on Meta/Google Policy changes. You will be the “living dictionary” for platform rules.

- **Review:** Audit content and Landing Pages before launching to ensure zero policy violations.

**4. System Support (10%):**

- **Resource Management:** Coordinate with the Creative team to organize and store Creative Assets scientifically for easy retrieval.

- **Admin:** Perform operational support tasks for the Marketing team.

### **III. JOB REQUIREMENTS**

- **Target Candidates:** Final-year students or fresh graduates **(Experience < 1.5 years)**.

- **Preferred Majors:** Marketing, Economics, Statistics, or Data Science fields with a passion for Marketing.

- **Meta/Google Ads:** Basic understanding of **Meta/Google Ads Management**. Prior experience running ads (dropship, affiliate, fanpage) is an advantage.

- **Technical Proficiency:**

**Video Editing:** Proficient in cutting, adding text/captions, and background music to support the Creative team.

- **AI Tools:** Proficient in using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude, and video editing tools like Sora, Veo, or Kling.

- **English:** Equivalent to IELTS 6.5+ (**Special focus on Reading & Comprehension**). You must read Facebook/Google Policies in English as fluently as reading daily news. 100% Global working environment.

### **IV. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

- **Unlimited Income:** Competitive base salary **starting from 15,000,000 VND** (negotiable based on capability) + Annual Performance Bonus (based on % of revenue growth you generate). You have the right to value yourself and negotiate with us.

- **Structured Training:** Direct mentorship from Senior Performance Marketers managing multi-million dollar budgets.

- **Advancement Opportunities:** A clear roadmap to becoming a Junior/Senior after 6–12 months if performance is proven.

- **Tools:** Provided with learning accounts and access to licensed AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT Plus, etc.).

- **Comprehensive Benefits:** Social Insurance, Bao Viet Health Insurance (Green Card), bi-annual company trips, and full holiday/birthday bonuses.

### **V. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

- **Recruitment Process: **To ensure we find the right “Builders” for our x20 goal, our process includes:

**Round 1 - Application & Technical Challenge: **After submitting your CV (with Portfolio attached), you will receive a technical challenge.

- **Round 2 - In-depth Interview: **A discussion regarding technical expertise and cultural fit with PATI’s management team.

- **Round 3 - Founder’s Table: **Direct strategic discussion with the CEO.

- **Working Conditions:**

**Time:**

Monday - Friday: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM, with a 1-hour lunch break.

- Saturday (Culture Day): 6:30 AM - 09:00 AM. We kick off Saturdays with team runs and weekly reflections - mind, body, and momentum aligned.

- **Location:** PATI Group Office – Ho Chi Minh City.

- **Note:** This is a full-time, onsite position to ensure the highest speed of coordination.

[APPLY HERE](https://paticreativeagency.sg.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrlgvRYrNc3P4mwVPoRXDzeyQm)
